purpose: Teach: 柏崎/佐野/矢野/松永/白石/吉岡/小松/亀井

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、柏崎の電力会社と取引を始められた
lines.en: When you were young, Father, you began doing business with the Kashiwazaki power company.
lines.style: Slow, measured opening. Reminiscent tone—gazing backward. Gentle pride beneath the surface. Voice carries the weight of witnessed history, not judgment. Slight pause before the name, as if placing it carefully in time.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは佐野氏と共同事業を立ち上げられた
lines.en: Yes. Father took on a joint venture with Mr. Sano.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment. Clear and direct, but not clipped. A son answering his father's recollection with quiet certainty. Steady pace. The tone says: I know this story, and I honor it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、矢野先輩のご薫陶を受けられた
lines.en: And when you were young, Father, you received mentorship from senior Yano.
lines.style: Wistful, almost tender. Voice softens on the name. The speaker is honoring a person who shaped his father. Slight breathiness—this matters. Pace slows as if pausing to let the name land.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは松永氏と海外進出を企画された
lines.en: Yes. Father planned the overseas expansion with Mr. Matsunaga.
lines.style: Reflective, carrying quiet recognition. Not rushing. Voice has texture—not flat recitation but considered speech. The son is walking through his father's history with deliberate presence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、白石氏を広報の柱に据えられた
lines.en: And in those days, Father, you made Mr. Shiraishi the cornerstone of your public relations.
lines.style: Wistful again, but with admiration for the choice itself. Voice lands firmly on 'cornerstone'—this was a decision, a vision. Measured breath. The tone suggests: he knew what he was doing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは吉岡氏と経理体制を整えられた
lines.en: Yes. Father entrusted the entire accounting structure to Mr. Yoshioka.
lines.style: Composed, measured. The son is documenting his father's choices with respect. Voice is steady, not emotional—this is the work of leadership being named aloud. Each name receives its due weight.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、小松氏と海外法人を立ち上げられた
lines.en: When you were young, Father, you and Mr. Komatus established the overseas corporation.
lines.style: Wistful and gentle. The opening carries quiet awe—at the ambition, the capability. Breath is easy. The speaker's voice holds both wonder and the acceptance that this was who his father was.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは亀井氏に法務全般を委ねられた
lines.en: Yes. Father placed all legal matters in Mr. Kamei's capable hands.
lines.style: Closing statement with understated wisdom. Voice is calm, almost at rest. The final sentence of a biography being gently stated. Slight pause after 'capable hands'—this is the full picture, complete.
